minik.title: The Rookie
minik.tagline: Just started chess. Guards his pieces but rarely sees two moves ahead.

greeting: I have a feeling I'll win today!
botCaptures: Yoink! That piece is mine now.
botGivesCheck: Check! Didn't see that coming, did you?
playerGivesCheck: Uh-oh, my king is in danger!
draw: A draw! We were both good.

atli.title: Knight Master
atli.tagline: Loves surprise attacks with her knights.

greeting: My knights are ready. Are yours?
botCaptures: My knight saw that long ago.
playerGivesCheck: Not bad, but it's not over yet.
botLoses: You win this time. I want a rematch!

filiz.title: Master of Diagonals
filiz.tagline: Puts her bishops on long diagonals and waits patiently.

greeting: My bishops are on the long diagonals, waiting patiently.
botCaptures: The diagonal was open, so I took it.
playerCaptures: Hmm, I didn't count on that.

sultan.title: Boss of World 1
sultan.tagline: Never gives up the castle easily.

greeting: So you made it to my castle… Let's see what you've got.
playerCaptures: You took a piece? The castle still stands.
botGivesCheck: Check! You stand before the Sultan.
botWins: The castle did not fall. Come back stronger!
botLoses: The castle has fallen… You are a true champion!
draw: A draw. Both you and the castle still stand.
